svg.title: StepWise
svg.desc: StepWise. Best Idea Award. Work in progress. Step monitoring for people with Parkinson's disease: smart-shoe sensors, daily calendar and location feed a weekly classifier, and AI agents turn the data into one report for the physiotherapist. Process Mining and Intelligence, team of 4.
svg.text: Step monitoring for people with Parkinson’s disease. Smart-shoe
sensors, the daily calendar and location feed a weekly classifier;
AI agents turn the data into one report for the physiotherapist.
Wearable sensors | Machine learning | AI agents | Workflow design
